newsitem.title: SPAIN: S&P confirms Spain's Community of Valencia rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P confirms Spain's Community of Valencia rating.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard & Poor's confirmed on Wednesday its AA minus senior debt and A-1 plus ratings on the commercial paper of Spain's Autonomous Community of Valencia (Valencia regional government).
S&P added in a note that the rating outlook is stable.
It said the ratings reflected Valencia's sizeable and stable operating surpluses, its manageable debt level and its fairly diversified economy.
In the last four years, operating surpluses of the Valencia regional government ranged between five and six percent of operating revenues.
In 1995 the Community of Valencia had a budget deficit before debt repayment of 5.4 percent of total revenues.
The S&P note concluded that the direct debt of the region, at 48 percent of operating revenues in 1995, compared well with other Spanish autonomous regions and with international standards.
